description:
**Day 1 of Google's Advent of Agents — Season 2**

Welcome to **Season 2** of Advent of Agents! A fresh season of AI Agent tutorials blooms this spring.

31 days. 31 tutorials. Production-Ready AI Agents on Google Cloud.

**Every day in March you will:**

-  🌱 Learn one new concept or feature to explore
-  💻 Build an agent with copy-paste commands that actually work
-  📖 Explore links to docs and resources

From advanced agent patterns to multi-agent orchestration. From prototyping to production deployment.

**What's New in Season 2:** Building on the foundations from Season 1, this season goes deeper:

-  [Agent Development Kit](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/): Build agents with the latest ADK features
-  [Vertex AI Agent Engine](https://cloud.google.com/products/agent-builder): Scale your agents to production
-  [Agent Starter Pack](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/agent-starter-pack): E2E production-ready templates

**Getting Started:** New to agents? Check out the Kaggle’s [Introduction to Agents whitepaper](https://www.kaggle.com/whitepaper-introduction-to-agents) and browse the [Season 1 Archive](http://adventofagents.com/2025/12/) to catch up on the fundamentals.

**Let's build something amazing this spring! 🌸**
